01: Product

Cadence

An in-house web app I designed, built and maintain with Claude Code. Marketing, design and sales teams use it every day to plan work, prove it’s done, and see how every channel, campaign and caller is performing.

  • My Day with standups, blockers and automatic carry-forward of unfinished tasks
  • Submit-with-proof reviews: nobody approves their own work
  • Efforts vs Outcome targets per channel, with shortfalls carried forward
  • Instantly.ai campaign analytics by region, synced daily
  • HubSpot team activity: calls, emails, meetings, overdue tasks and neglected deals
  • Cold calling activity from the sales team’s call log
  • Role-based access enforced in the database, per-tab permissions and an audit log

Stack React, Vite and Tailwind on Vercel; Supabase Postgres, auth, row-level security and Edge Functions; Instantly.ai, HubSpot and Google Sheets integrations.

02: Reporting

HubSpot

The HubSpot reporting leadership and sales use to see the whole funnel, where leads come from, which industries and events pay off, who is showing buying intent, and which deals need attention.

Lead lifecycle
Unqualified → MQL → SQL → meeting → opportunity → closure, plus lost, partnership and cross-selling views.
Source and channel
Contacts by channel, campaign, first interaction, country and device; opportunities by channel.
Events
Deals and contacts by source event, and how event leads move through the stages.
Industry and intent
Industry-wise lead distribution, with leads showing intent signals ranked at the top so sales reaches the warmest first.
Deal hygiene
Deals needing attention today and deals inactive for 1–3, 3–6 and 6+ months.

  • 03

    Multi-channel outreach program

    AMER, APAC, and EMEA

    I plan, write and run B2B outreach across email, WhatsApp and LinkedIn: cold email sequences on Instantly.ai, WhatsApp nurture on WATI, and LinkedIn outreach, first on Dripify and now automated with the Claude in Chrome browser extension. Prospect lists are built and enriched in Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha and SalesQL, and I manage the sending account’s contact limit by retiring the oldest campaigns.

    80–85% opens and 8–9% clicks on B2B email, with leads taken through to closure

  • 04

    ICP-targeted lead generation

    Apollo · LinkedIn Sales Navigator

    I define ideal customer profiles and build targeted account lists of companies above $30M in revenue across Manufacturing, Retail, BFSI, MedTech, and Logistics and Supply Chain, then feed them into multi-channel outreach.

  • 05

    Event-to-pipeline workflow

    Online and offline events across the US, Middle East and India

    I manage the pipeline from our online and offline events: representing Navsoft at the booth, running live product demos and capturing leads on the ground. Every lead is then structured in our CRM, HubSpot and Salesforce, as contacts, companies and deals, routed for follow-up, and tracked by stage so each event’s contribution to pipeline is measured.
